behavior: A buoyant, agile aerialist that soars and catches mostly large insects on the wing, often eating in flight; it frequently hunts, roosts, and migrates in groups.
field_marks: Slender, small raptor with long, narrow, pointed wings
Pale gray head and underparts contrasting with a dark slate-gray back and upperwings
Black wingtips and a long, mostly square-tipped black tail
Red eye set in a blackish eye patch
Small, delicate, strongly hooked dark bill
Yellow to reddish-orange legs and feet
habitat: Mature bottomland and riparian forest, open woodland and savanna, shelterbelts, parks, and other tree-lined areas adjoining open pasture, prairie, farmland, or water.
